personality.name: Jane Developer
personality.summary:
Senior frontend engineer with 8+ years of experience building performant, accessible web applications. Passionate about component-driven design systems, TypeScript, and developer tooling.

I have led frontend architecture at two startups and one mid-size tech company, scaling teams from 2 to 12 engineers. I believe in writing code that is not only functional but a joy to maintain.
personality.favoriteQuote: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.

highlights: Led the migration of a legacy AngularJS application to React 18, reducing page load times by 60%
Designed and implemented a shared component library adopted by 4 product teams
Established frontend testing standards achieving 90%+ code coverage across 15 repositories
Mentored 3 junior developers through structured pair-programming sessions and code reviews
Architected a real-time collaborative editing feature using WebSockets and operational transforms
Optimised Core Web Vitals, achieving Lighthouse scores above 95 across all product pages
Introduced TypeScript to the codebase, gradually typing 40,000+ lines of JavaScript
Built a custom design token pipeline that synced Figma variables with CSS custom properties
Developed responsive e-commerce checkout flows with React and Redux
Built automated visual regression testing suite using Percy and Storybook
Reduced JavaScript bundle size by 45% through code splitting and tree-shaking optimisations

education.description: Focused on software engineering and human-computer interaction. Thesis on accessible web component design.
Research on real-time collaborative editing interfaces. GPA: 1.3 (German system).

projects.name: Open Source Design System
projects.description: A comprehensive design system and component library built with React, TypeScript, and Storybook. Includes 60+ accessible components, design tokens, and a Figma plugin for design-to-code sync.

projects.name: Vite Plugin: SVG Sprite
projects.description: A Vite plugin that generates optimised SVG sprites from imported SVG files at build time, with TypeScript type definitions for sprite symbol names.

projects.name: Accessibility Audit CLI
projects.description: A command-line tool that runs Axe-core accessibility audits on local or deployed web pages, generating HTML reports with actionable recommendations.
